summary: Frontend-only regression after useFetch refactor (useFocusEffect refetch + AppState settings refresh). Mobile viewport 390x844 on preview https://pharma360-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com against LIVE API https://pharma360benak.com/api. ALL 11 targeted screens loaded correctly without red screen, without loading-stuck state, and without infinite refetch loops. Verified: Home (hero + subtitle + top-bar ticker 'Livraison rapide dans toutes les wilayas...' + fidelite teaser + gift banners + brands + blog + Footer with brand tagline & socials), Catalogue (search input debounced + chip filters), Product detail /produit/{id} with add-to-cart-btn testID, Marques, Blog, Idées cadeaux, Fidelite, Panier, Compte, Carte-cadeau, Checkout (renders without crash), Pharmacie (Email row + Itinéraire button present). Focus-refetch validated: returning Home from Catalogue triggered 11 network requests (fresh data, not stuck cache). Multi-navigation Home->Catalogue->Home->Catalogue->Home fired 26 requests then 6s idle = 0 requests → NO infinite refetch loop / no flicker. Login with app.test.1787653725@pharma360test.com/Test12345 succeeds via 'Se connecter' entry on /compte → Mon Compte shows 'App Test' + '0 points'; session persists across navigation. Only console noise = known benign 401 on guest /favorites and pointerEvents/shadow* deprecation warnings (already reported in iteration_2). No new bugs introduced by the refactor.

integration_issues.issue: GET /favorites still called without token on public screens → 401 in console (benign, UI shows empty state). Same as iteration_2, not regressed.

issues: Still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (react-native-web).
Still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".'
Still present: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' (expected on web).

action_items: (Carry-over from iteration_2) Guard /favorites hydration behind an auth-token check to remove 401 noise for guests.
(Carry-over) Migrate legacy 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents to clear deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: useFetch (src/lib/useFetch.ts) correctly uses useFocusEffect with a stable key derived from path+query, and cleans up with the active flag → no double-set-state after unmount, no runaway loop observed.

ThemeProvider (src/theme/theme.tsx) refetches /settings on AppState 'active' and Home also calls refreshSettings() in useFocusEffect → admin-driven fields (hero subtitle, ticker, footer tagline/socials, giftcard_enabled, loyalty_enabled) reflect after refocus.
api.ts already uses cache:'no-store' → no stale HTTP cache.
Home fires 6 useFetch hooks + settings refresh on focus (~7 network calls); acceptable and matches observed 8 initial + 11 on refocus. No thrashing.
Idle 6s after multiple screen transitions produced 0 additional network requests → confirms no interval/loop leak introduced by the refactor.

The refactor (useFocusEffect + AppState refresh + cache:'no-store') behaves as intended: screens refetch on focus, settings refresh on app foreground/Home focus, and there is no infinite refetch loop (verified 6s idle after heavy navigation = 0 network deltas).
